title: Shipping overview
text: Shipping unions authorized projects’ bounded live/recent windows before presentation, showing shared releases once; a busy project cannot truncate another’s releases. Project chips match member projects or an itemless run’s owner. An explicit Shipping entry reads its authorized overview alongside project and saved-selection startup; first paint keeps the saved filter. Shipping announces loading, then paints before auxiliary QA evidence or flow names load. Source-only Not started rows and available release facts appear independently; loading and failed evidence reads stay explicit. Member QA retains the release gate’s acceptance authority, and landing attribution keeps the first successful delivery in each environment. Deployed timing remains subject to production proof. Each presentation batches current QA facts with canonical acceptance checks: unrun cases stay unrun; later calls see changed withdrawals and verdicts. The CLI overview diagnoses scope; browser, HTTP and handler timing still need production proof. Environment names, case definitions, copy targets and decoded source bindings are reused only within one overview. Cards and QA facts omit driver preparation receipts; detail and recovery retain them. Query plans alone exclude transport, decoding and Python work; actual execution counts and deployed timing remain required. Executable QA content identity treats equal JSON numeric values such as 180 and 180.0 alike. Serialization alone cannot make a matching deployment copy appear source-only; changed values or JSON types still mean changed content. This correction remains subject to deployed proof. Completed execution rows are read once for displayed runs; selected rows retain the canonical roster and target checks, and later requests reread changed execution evidence. Shared-copy ownership selects group targets once per run, stage and member within one presentation; later requests repeat canonical selection and observe changed attachments. The run page, Shipping and the Inbox share one grouping and count rule from the run-scoped QA activity read: a plan several members attach is drawn once under Run QA, labelled with its sharing items, and each sharing item shows only its own checks plus a pointer to that plan; an item whose every check is shared keeps a “0 own checks” tile. Every check counts once: retracted and superseded checks leave passed, queued and open counts and appear only in history, and a removed member shows as removed with its cancelled count rather than as open QA. This rule is observed in source and tests; production presentation of a live shared release remains to be proven. Verdict reads omit output but preserve actual-attempt order and ambiguity checks; full details retain output. Member obligation, acceptance and sharing reads reuse frozen snapshots and live attachments per evaluation; copy matching reads identity and executable fields.
